tests.name: constructor throws the capacity message for every invalid capacity
constructor validates capacity first, then ttlMs, then now
constructor throws the ttlMs message for invalid ttlMs and the now message for invalid now
constructor accepts ttlMs 0 and defaults now to Date.now when omitted
set/get round-trip with overwrite, and a missing key yields undefined/false/false/0
size counts stored entries, and delete removes an entry so later reads miss
undefined is a valid value and keys use SameValueZero including NaN and -0
delete removes a stored entry regardless of state and subsequent reads miss
an entry written at t expires exactly at its deadline t+ttlMs (inclusive boundary)
get and has on an expired entry return their falsy result and lazily remove it
size excludes expired entries but never mutates state
re-setting an expired key stores a fresh record with a new deadline and revived reads
set over an expired stored entry refreshes deadline and recency without a spurious eviction
delete works on an expired-but-stored entry, and ttlMs 0 entries are dead on any read
inserting one more entry than capacity evicts the least-recently-used stored entry
a successful get refreshes recency so the touched key survives eviction
set over an existing key refreshes recency, while has and size never change it
a failed (expired) get removes the entry and leaves the recency of the rest untouched
delete removes the key from recency consideration and size never triggers eviction
eviction ignores expiry, and a capacity 1 cache holds only the most recent key
